steps: If you land on 'Welcome back', choose 'Create the first User' and sign up with email naive@example.com and password 'naive user password'
If sign-up says it is closed, go to sign in and use the same email and password

coverageNotes: Serve the built app (npm run build:web, then npm run preview --workspace web) against an API on 127.0.0.1:3333 using a disposable database, never keeper data. Already scripted in Chromium, so skip repeating them: the empty-install signup → Add Tank → sign out → sign in → log a water change → reload journey; Add Tank field errors and a failed create; water change field errors, offline-disabled save and a failed save; deep links, a missing Tank, API URLs opened in the browser and the offline shell. Explore instead: the dashboard and Tank cards, Add Tank with odd names and volumes, the Tank detail and its water change log, the log form's date/percentage/note, back and forward navigation, keyboard-only use, and anything a first-time keeper would try that the app does not explain.
